dataset: one example per line: 128 finite state floats followed by one integer target index
training: repeated opcode124 guest softmax SGD steps
evaluation: opcode124 with lr=0; per-example guest loss aggregated as a host metric
gate: candidate_heldout_nll < baseline_heldout_nll, both finite; strict improvement
scope: readout checkpoint gate only; tensor_promotion=false; no 48M decoder or 1 MiB page training
note: The guest computes all model loss/gradients; the host only aggregates the reported metric and checks the gate.
